'''QO-99''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] of unknown origins that served in the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit known as the [[Specialists]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The unit was led by the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] known as the [[Ratcatcher]], and QO-99 operated the Ratcatcher's [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] and [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]].
